name: imdb_id
definition: IMDb ID, the join key for every table

name: as_of_date
definition: Release date of the film; features must only use data before it

name: movie_name
definition: Title with year, as in MovieSum

name: year
definition: Release year parsed from the MovieSum title

name: year_split
definition: train through 2017, validate 2018-2019, skip 2020-2021, test 2022 on

name: genres
definition: Genre list for the film (stands in for a script-based genre guess)

name: genre_primary
definition: First genre listed

name: script_words_clean
definition: Words in the script with markup tags removed

name: est_pages
definition: script words / 200 (rule of thumb)

name: est_runtime_min
definition: Estimated runtime in minutes: 1 page = 1 minute

name: scene_count
definition: Number of scene headings found by the Scene parser

name: int_share
definition: Share of scenes inside (INT/EXT counts half each)

name: ext_share
definition: Share of scenes outside

name: night_share
definition: Night scenes / (day + night scenes); blank if no times known

name: unknown_time_share
definition: Share of scenes whose time of day could not be read

name: unique_locations
definition: Number of different location names in scene headings

name: scenes_per_location
definition: scene_count / unique_locations; high means few repeated sets

name: speaking_characters
definition: Number of different speaking characters

name: dialogue_lines
definition: Number of dialogue blocks

name: description_words
definition: Words in scene descriptions (action text)

name: profanity_strong_per_1k
definition: F-word forms per 1,000 words

name: profanity_other_per_1k
definition: Other strong swear words per 1,000 words

name: profanity_mild_per_1k
definition: Mild swear words (damn, hell, ass...) per 1,000 words

name: est_rating_language
definition: Rough G/PG/PG-13/R guess from language only, NOT validated

name: parse_mode
definition: strict, loose, text_fallback or no_headings: how the scenes were found

name: flag_low_confidence
definition: 1 if parse_mode is not strict or fewer than 30 scenes were found

name: flag_genre_missing
definition: 1 if no TMDB genre was found

definition: 1 if the film has this genre (multi-hot)

name: features_version
definition: Version of the feature code that made the row

name: budget_nominal
definition: Production budget in dollars of the release year (TMDB); blank if under $10,000

name: gross_nominal
definition: Worldwide gross in release-year dollars (TMDB); blank if under $10,000

name: inflation_factor
definition: US CPI at the latest month divided by CPI at the release month

name: budget_adj
definition: Budget in today's dollars = budget_nominal x inflation_factor

name: gross_adj
definition: Gross in today's dollars

name: budget_band_adj
definition: micro <$1M, low $1-10M, mid $10-40M, high $40-100M, tentpole $100M+, on budget_adj

name: budget_band_nominal
definition: Same bands on the unadjusted budget (for comparison only)

name: flag_budget_usable
definition: 1 if the budget is at least $10,000

name: flag_no_release_date
definition: 1 if the release date was missing and mid-year of the title year was used

name: flag_cpi_extrapolated
definition: 1 if the film predates the first CPI month (1947) and the first month was used

name: budget_table_version
definition: Version of the budget table code

name: year_gap
definition: Years between the MovieSum title year and the TMDB release year

name: flag_year_mismatch
definition: 1 if year_gap is 2 or more: the TMDB match is probably a different film (e.g. a remake)
